title: Truthful compromise and insurance on a sphere
abstract: arXiv:2611.17701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can public choice without transfers insure conflicting interests when action intensity is fixed? We require truthful reporting for every increasing-concave evaluation of alignment with private ideals. On a sphere, efficiency at profiles with at most three ideal directions forces fixed-weight random dictatorship; weaker tests suffice in two and three dimensions. From four dimensions, binary efficiency permits committees to insure members by placing outcome risk orthogonally to their reports. We identify restrictions shared by all mechanisms with these incentives and binary efficiency: binary winning probabilities determine mean outcomes at every profile and individual alignment distributions at planar three-camp profiles. When these probabilities depend only on camp size, complete insurance at balanced equilateral disagreement requires dimension proportional to population. translated_title: 球面上的真实妥协与保险
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.17701v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当行动强度固定时，不含转移支付的公共选择能否为相互冲突的利益提供保险？我们要求机制在对与私人理想对齐程度的每一种递增凹评估下都保持真实报告。在球面上，对于至多包含三个理想方向的偏好组合，效率性必然导致固定权重的随机独裁；而在二维和三维空间中，较弱的检验即可满足要求。从四维开始，二元效率允许委员会通过将结果风险置于与成员报告正交的方向上，来为成员提供保险。我们识别出所有具备这些激励性质与二元效率的机制共同遵循的限制：二元获胜概率决定了每个偏好组合下的平均结果，以及平面三阵营偏好组合下的个体对齐分布。当这些获胜概率仅取决于阵营规模时，在平衡等边分歧情形下实现完全保险要求维度与人口规模成比例。相比之下，委员会能够降低每个参与者的福利损失（摘要在此处似乎被截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明在球面公共选择中，要求真实报告且有效率的机制在至多三个理想方向时必然退化为固定权重随机独裁，而从四维起委员会可通过将结果风险置于报告正交方向为成员提供保险，且完全保险需要维度与人口规模成比例。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that on a sphere, truthful and efficient public choice with at most three ideal directions forces fixed-weight random dictatorship, while from dimension four onward committees can insure members by placing outcome risk orthogonally to their reports, with full insurance requiring dimension proportional to population.
